input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 is an undefined-scope exclusivity/field-of-use restriction binding Customer: it prevents us from sourcing (or arguably building) any hosted analytics services from anyone else for the whole term, with no product-level scope, no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions, and no cap. That breaches the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) and contradicts Section 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment). Preferred remedy is deletion; the fallback (named competing product, term only, 12-month cap, internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) is offered in the comment if Vendor needs protection.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the sole-source exclusivity in Section 2.2 because we cannot restrict the analytics services we buy or build, and it conflicts with Sections 2.1 and 12.3. If Vendor needs protection, we could consider a narrow, term-only restriction tied to a named competing product, capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.summary: Delete Vendor sole and exclusive provider commitment binding Customer.
